{{Quote|An AquaHarvester, like a farm, is a renewable food source that has to be occasionally rebuilt.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
An '''AquaHarvester''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] structure built to gather [[Fish/Legends|fish]], which could then be gathered by [[utility trawler]]s. One AquaHarvester was built on the suggestion of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] on a river near a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]]. Several AquaHarvesters were present in the [[Montrosa Ocean]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reytha]] during the [[Reytha campaign|campaign]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to retake the planet from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Select one of your utility trawlers and choose 'build AquaHarvester'.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
AquaHarvesters appear in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', as a structure the player can create. Unlike most buildings in the game AquaHarvesters have the same appearance aside from the player colours regardless of the civilization that builds them.<ref name="GB" />
